    - list:
      - listitem: The trigger opens a dialog; each month is a grid and every day button has its full date as name
      - listitem: Today is marked with aria-current (and a small blue dot), picked days with aria-selected; the month name is announced when it changes
      - listitem: Focus moves with the arrow keys and returns to the trigger when the panel closes
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The panel opens with a short scale and fade; months slide in from the side you're moving to and the calendars glide to their new height while the Cancel / Apply row stays in place
      - listitem: After the first click the band follows the pointer as a lighter preview until the second click
      - listitem: The picked ends are dark chips with a light gray band between them; the comparison period appears as a soft blue band with hairline ends
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Below 600px the presets turn into a scrolling row of tab chips and only the month the range ends in is shown; the footer stacks
      - listitem: The panel is as wide as the screen allows (up to 652px); set --ui-drpc-panel-width, e.g. to 100%, to match your layout
      - listitem: Bigger day cells and buttons on touch screens
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
